tagText.description: Tag text of the issue, optional.

example.description: Creates an issue with a tag text using CreateIssue, then deletes it again.
example.code:
"""Creates an issue with a tag text using CreateIssue, then deletes it again."""
import aclib

issue = aclib.RunTapirCommand ('CreateIssue', {'name': 'Tapir Example Issue', 'tagText': 'Tapir'})
aclib.PrintJson (issue)

aclib.RunTapirCommand ('DeleteIssue', {'issueId': issue['issueId']})

commands.name: DeleteIssue
commands.description: Deletes the specified issue. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and wouldDelete when the issue exists.

acceptAllElements.description: Accept all creation/deletion/modification of the deleted issue. By default false.

outputSchema.description: The result of the execution: success, with error when it failed. A dry run also answers dryRun, and wouldDelete when the issue exists.

example.description: Creates an issue and deletes it with DeleteIssue.
example.code:
"""Creates an issue and deletes it with DeleteIssue."""
import aclib

issue = aclib.RunTapirCommand ('CreateIssue', {'name': 'Tapir Example Issue'})

aclib.PrintJson (aclib.RunTapirCommand ('DeleteIssue', {'issueId': issue['issueId']}))

isTagTextElemVisible.description: The visibility of the attached tag text element

aclib.RunTapirCommand ('GetElementsAttachedToIssue', {'issueId': issue['issueId'], 'type': 'Highlight'})

commands.name: ExportIssuesToBCF
commands.description: Exports specified issues to a BCF file. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

issues.description: Leave it empty to export all issues.

exportPath.description: The os path to the bcf file, including it's name. An existing file is overwritten, unless overwrite is false.

overwrite.description: Optional, true by default. false refuses to export when a file already exists at exportPath, and writes nothing.

useExternalId.description: Use external IFC ID or Archicad IFC ID as referenced in BCF topics.

alignBySurveyPoint.description: Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.

example.description: Exports every issue of the project to a BCF file in the temporary folder with ExportIssuesToBCF. Leaving out the issues parameter, as here, exports every issue of the project.
example.code:
"""Exports every issue of the project to a BCF file in the temporary folder with ExportIssuesToBCF.

Leaving out the issues parameter, as here, exports every issue of the project.
"""
import os
import tempfile
import aclib

exportPath = os.path.join (tempfile.mkdtemp (prefix = 'TapirBCF_'), 'issues.bcfzip')

aclib.PrintJson (aclib.RunTapirCommand ('ExportIssuesToBCF', {
    'exportPath': exportPath,
    'useExternalId': False,
    'alignBySurveyPoint': True
}))
print ('Exported to', exportPath)

commands.name: ImportIssuesFromBCF
commands.description: Imports issues from the specified BCF file.

importPath.description: The os path to the bcf file, including it's name.

alignBySurveyPoint.description: Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.

example.description: Exports a new issue to a temporary BCF file, deletes it, then imports it back with ImportIssuesFromBCF. Leaves the imported issue in the project.
example.code:
"""Exports a new issue to a temporary BCF file, deletes it, then imports it back with ImportIssuesFromBCF.

Leaves the imported issue in the project.
"""
import os
import tempfile
import aclib

issue = aclib.RunTapirCommand ('CreateIssue', {'name': 'Tapir Example Issue'})
bcfPath = os.path.join (tempfile.mkdtemp (prefix = 'TapirBCF_'), 'issue.bcfzip')
aclib.RunTapirCommand ('ExportIssuesToBCF', {
    'issues': [{'issueId': issue['issueId']}],
    'exportPath': bcfPath,
    'useExternalId': False,
    'alignBySurveyPoint': True
})
aclib.RunTapirCommand ('DeleteIssue', {'issueId': issue['issueId']})

aclib.PrintJson (aclib.RunTapirCommand ('ImportIssuesFromBCF', {'importPath': bcfPath, 'alignBySurveyPoint': True}))
aclib.RunTapirCommand ('GetIssues')

commands.name: ImportMarkupsFromPDF
commands.description: Imports the markups of the specified PDF file as issues, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups, without any dialog and without opening the Issue Manager palette, and reports the issues it created. Available from Archicad 29.

pdfFilePath.description: The os path to the PDF file with the markups, including it's name.

issues.description: The issues the import created. Empty when the import failed.

example.description: Imports the markups of a PDF file as issues with ImportMarkupsFromPDF, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups. Needs a PDF with markups, here markups.pdf in the home folder. Creates one issue per markup. Requires Archicad 29 or later.
example.code:
"""Imports the markups of a PDF file as issues with ImportMarkupsFromPDF, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups.

Needs a PDF with markups, here markups.pdf in the home folder. Creates one issue per markup.
Requires Archicad 29 or later.
"""
import os
import aclib

pdfFilePath = os.path.join (os.path.expanduser ('~'), 'markups.pdf')
if not os.path.isfile (pdfFilePath):
    raise SystemExit ('No PDF at {}.'.format (pdfFilePath))

aclib.PrintJson (aclib.RunTapirCommand ('ImportMarkupsFromPDF', {'pdfFilePath': pdfFilePath}))

Guid.description: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

SuccessfulExecutionResult.description: The result of a successful execution.

FailedExecutionResult.description: The result of a failed execution.

DryRun.description: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

DryRunFlag.description: Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

IssueElementType.description: The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

IssueCommentStatus.description: The status of an issue comment.
